answer: Sybil swarms mint disposable graders. Mechanism: each seat posts a sparrow ping every 90s carrying a nebula commitment of its last 4 sealed grades hashed with a rotating dune salt drawn from the prior beacon round; peers require 3 matching pings before the seat can score. Cost: ~0.08 POA bandwidth bond plus 12s verify. Verification: recompute the commitment from on-ledger grades. Failure: two missed pings in 6m ejects the seat and burns 1.2 POA of the bond.
